correctness.rationale: The source proves \(\operatorname{Hull}(C)=\operatorname{im}\phi\cap\ker\phi^\dagger\) and that a nonzero adjoint kernel in the Frobenius case is an \(\mathbb F_{q^d}\)-line. Independently, \(d\mid k\) and \(d\mid(m-k)\) make both \(\phi\) and \(\phi^\dagger\) \(\mathbb F_{q^d}\)-linear for arbitrary full-field parameters. Thus the image is an \(\mathbb F_{q^d}\)-subspace and its intersection with the zero space or a one-dimensional \(\mathbb F_{q^d}\)-kernel has \(\mathbb F_q\)-dimension only \(0\) or \(d\). The nonzero-kernel-line fact is also reconstructed directly by taking the ratio of two nonzero kernel elements. The bundled verifier exhausts representative binary extension fields and returns VERIFY_OK; those finite checks are explicitly not used as the general proof.
